nom: SOME BY MI AHA BHA PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Body Cleanser

avis.titre: IT REALLY REALLY WORKSIT REALLY REALLY WORKS
avis.texte: IT REALLY WORKS. I don’t typically write reviews, but I’m the type of person who relies on reviews when purchasing stuff so I figured someone out there is likely the same way. I know some people said theirs came broken or leaking, mine did not! As for its efficiency, I began using this body wash in January of this year, and in just 4 months my bacne is GONE. I’ve been struggling with bacne for about two years now and the only changes I made to my life is using this body wash. It doesn’t have a strong fragrance but there is a light one if your skin is super sensitive to that stuff. I didn’t have any skin irritation nor did my bacne get worse before getting better. It definitely will improve in 30 days, but if you want it completely gone- use it longer than that. I used it once a day for at least 3 weeks before I moved on to using it about every other day. Now I use it maybe once or twice a week. More if I feel like it. My back feels pretty moisturized but not in the same way an oil or lotion would, so if you like baby soft skin, you could realistically put some lotion on afterwards. I love this product and I’m buying it for my family too. 10/10

avis.titre: Cleared up stubborn body acne without. drying out my skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using the SOME BY MI AHA BHA PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Body Cleanser for several weeks, and I’m really impressed with the results. I mainly bought it for occasional back and shoulder breakouts, and I’ve noticed fewer new blemishes and smoother skin since I started using it consistently. The tea tree scent is clean and refreshing without being overpowering. It lathers well, rinses off easily, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling stripped or overly dry like some acne body washes do. I also like that it’s sulfate and paraben free. The salicylic acid seems to help keep my pores clear, and with regular use my skin feels much smoother overall. As with most acne products, it takes a little patience, but sticking with it paid off. If you’re dealing with body acne and want a gentle cleanser that’s effective enough for daily use, I’d definitely recommend giving this one a try.

avis.titre: Best body wash I've ever used
avis.texte: Only been using for a few days and already see a difference. I bought this because no matter how many scrubs, body washes, and showers I take I still got acne on my butt. (Which is such an embarrassing thing to deal with as a women) It effects my love life and confidence. This I can tell will be a repurchased product. The level of clean and the amount it foams up is impressive. My skin is already clearing up. I'd imagine at this rate it'll be completely gone within a couple of weeks.

I thought this product was helping my body acne, things started to clear up pretty well. But after a few clear days, everything came back on my back, arms and chest. It seems to help for a few days and then my skin freaks out again. So still searching for something different.

avis.titre: Might not be dry skin friendly
avis.texte: Lots of lather and fragrance. I tend to use fragrance free skin care but I don’t mind the smell. It is too drying for my skin. Definitely wouldn’t go near it in the winter. Doubt I’d repurchase or try other Some By Mi products. Update: After getting through about half the bottle, I’ve updated to four stars. Still a no for dry winter but I’ve noticed a difference with my skin. It does work better for odors and skin condition. It does feel more drying and skin stripping after you shower but my skin isn’t drying out or having any irritation from it. I’m liking it more as I’m using it.

avis.texte: really like this body wash! It feels gentle on my skin and leaves my body feeling clean, soft, and refreshed. It doesn’t dry out my skin, and I love how comfortable my skin feels after showering. Definitely a great product for everyday use!

Foams up well. Soft to the skin and worth what it says it does. Purchased a second time for the men in the family.

avis.titre: Helps me look slightly less dreadful 🥹😍
avis.texte: Love this! I have typical Irish thin, pale, reactive skin, always some kind of rash or spot, even aloe vera gel irritates it, and the redness and imperfections show up even more when you're white as a sheet. 🤦🏼‍♀️😆 As well as helping clear spots fast without itching, burning or peeling, this stuff helps take the redness out of my "angry skin" in general - even razor rash, surprisingly - and, as a nice bonus, smells nice and fresh.
Soothing. Mild scent. Use this product everyday. A little expensive but I buy it when it’s on sale. Leaves my skin clean, soft and fairly clear

avis.titre: Messy packaging but good quality item
avis.texte: I love this product but this time when I received it, the soap had leaked in shipping.

This is my second purchase of this bodywash. I love the fresh tea tree smell and the way it cleanses my skin. I use it with an exfoliating rag and I feel squeaky clean. One thing that I did notice is that it lathers well and it helped with my hyperpigmentation. I noticed after almost finishing the bottle, the skin on my neck was peeling! So just a caution to how often you use it. I pair it with this other kojic bodywash which really helps to even out my complexion. With continued use, I would expect to see results in two to three weeks. Tip: This body wash is good at cleaning and removing grime/sweat but might be a bit drying on the skin for some due to the cosmetic acids AHA, BHA, and PHA. If you find that it dries your skin, follow up with a moisturizing body wash such as Dove Bar or Shea Moisture Soap Bar.

avis.titre: Actually made a difference — even after one use
avis.texte: I bought this for my husband, who struggles with back acne and redness, especially after workouts. We weren't expecting instant results, but we took a before/after photo out of curiosity — and were genuinely surprised. After just one use, his skin looked noticeably less red and inflamed. The gel texture is refreshing, has a light tea tree scent (not overpowering), and lathers really well. It rinses clean without leaving any residue or dryness. We’ll keep using it daily to see how it works long-term, but this first impression is honestly impressive. Highly recommend giving it a try if you're looking for a gentle yet effective body acne wash that actually shows results.

avis.texte: Item arrived dirty and leaking. A good portion of the product was missing from the bottle upon delivery. Other than that I have noticed a difference in my skin since I've started using it. I would recommend pairing with the lotion if your skin can tolerate it.

avis.titre: Good results, but not a miracle cure
avis.texte: I liked this product overall — it was gentle on my skin and helped improve my acne over time. However, I didn’t find the results to be particularly fast or dramatic. I’ve used other treatments that worked quicker for me, so while this one is effective, it requires a bit more patience. Still, I think it’s a good option for mild to moderate acne, especially if you’re looking for something that won’t irritate sensitive skin.
